STATEMENT OF WORK (SYNTHETIC — CORE-200 TEST FIXTURE — DISTRACTOR)
Solicitation No.: SYN-F-0006
Title: Base Dining Facility Custodial and Grounds-Keeping Services

1. SCOPE
The Contractor shall provide custodial services and grounds-keeping
for the base dining facility and surrounding walkways, including
daily trash removal, floor care, and seasonal landscaping.

2. REQUIREMENTS
2.1 Daily custodial service of dining facility common areas.
2.2 Weekly grounds mowing and edging during the growing season.
2.3 Monthly deep-clean of kitchen common areas (non-food-prep zones).

3. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE
Base dining facility, notional installation.
